title: Norwegian-Style Chorizo Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by Norwegian and North African cuisine. This chorizo tagine is gluten-free, making it a great option for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Heat the light in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the browned chorizo back to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the whole tagine to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the tagine for 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Serve with gluten-free bread or over rice.
